description:
Demand derivation re-runs once per call-chain level, and walks the whole chain on every run.
Approved proposal (2026-09-26): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-afu.3.html
(artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/YT7S1GcnSwxxRTM3ctW5qR).
Built on fz-afu.2 (PR #243, bf70cf13e).

## Reduced case
  def h(x), do: x
  def g(x), do: h(x)
  def f(x), do: g(x)
  def main(), do: f(1)
Measured on fz-afu.2: 74 runs / 56 subjects (scratchpad wave2/small/c4.*).
DeriveInputDemand 7 (f/1: 3, woken by EntryDispatch of g then h), DeriveRuntimeDemand 10
(main 3, f 3, g 2: woken by the next DeriveRuntimeDemand's RuntimeDemandInputs),
DeriveCallGraphComponent 8, AnalyzeActivation 11 (fz-afu.4), ScopeCode 4 (true chain),
other kinds 34.
Reads on Enum.take (`def main(), do: Enum.take([1, 2, 3], 2)`): DeriveInputDemand 2071
facts read over 102 runs (max 77 in one run), DeriveCallGraphComponent 520 (max 51),
DeriveRuntimeDemand 464 (max 8), AnalyzeActivation 1519 (max 21).

## What changes
1. DeriveRuntimeDemand: a blocked run publishes nothing. runtime_demand.rs:145-162 today
   adds peer_waits AND publishes with the missing peer's demand defaulted to ignore
   (unwrap_or_default). For a peer outside the function's own recursive component the run
   waits and concludes nothing; not-yet-known is never published as ignore. For a peer in
   its own component (a genuine fixpoint) it keeps reading the current value and ascends.
   CallGraphComponent is settled when the job runs (SeedRoot gates on Recursive).
2. DeriveInputDemand composes from callee InputDemand. For a forwarded callee c outside
   f's component, the job waits on InputDemand(c) (a callee outside the component cannot
   depend back on f, so no deadlock) and joins its forwarded_dispatch/returned; these equal
   the least fixpoint solve_forwarded_demand (keying.rs:974-1006) computes at that edge,
   same slot indexing (keying.rs:592). collect_input_forwarding_graph walks only inside
   f's own component. Simulated on Enum.take: 2071 reads -> ~304, max 8 per run,
   order-independent.

## Not in this ticket
The DeriveCallGraphComponent walk (collect_static_graph) stays. Stopping it at a callee
with a known component was measured and fails: 472 -> 451 edge reads on Enum.take, none on
the chain (callers are computed before callees), and it misses a cycle when StaticCallees
grows later (keying.rs:69-72, 106-133). Its redesign is a separate ticket.

## Removal ledger
- the missing-peer default in derive_runtime_demand_fact (unwrap_or_default on a peer, and
  peer_waits riding beside a publish) -> a wait with no publish, outside the component.
- collect_input_forwarding_graph's walk across callees outside f's component, and its
  per-callee StaticCallees / EntryDispatch waits -> a wait on InputDemand(callee).

## Prediction (chain case)
DeriveInputDemand 7 -> 5, DeriveRuntimeDemand 10 -> 5, all others unchanged: 74 -> 67 runs
over 56 subjects. No DeriveInputDemand or DeriveRuntimeDemand re-run rows.

## Acceptance
- Written first: the chain as a census test pinning 67 runs / 56 subjects with no
  DeriveInputDemand/DeriveRuntimeDemand re-run rows; a recursive pair f <-> g beside it
  whose fixpoint converges to the same answer as today.
- Facts read pinned per kind: Enum.take DeriveInputDemand 2071 -> about 304, max 8 per run.
- Every fixture's output unchanged on interp, JIT and AOT. Pins only drop; a rise stops
  the build.
- Docs: .agent/docs/fact-engine.md (a blocked run publishes nothing) and the keying /
  runtime-demand sections describing these walks.

## Earlier findings, kept for reference
s1 (`def main(), do: 1`): the per-function StaticCallees -> EntryDispatch rungs became
gates in fz-afu.2. ScopeCode(17)'s two repeats are a true chain (source_publish.rs:346-361,
world.rs:1045-1060). AnalyzeActivation's blocked first run still publishes
ActivationAnalyzed / CallSiteSummary / CallSiteTargets / ReturnType rev 0 (fz-afu.4).
title: Demand derivation composes from callee facts instead of re-walking the chain
